nodes.label: Firestore rules IDOR fix (commit 1c24da0)
nodes.rationale: A prior IDOR vulnerability in firestore.rules allowed read/write on a document by ID without validating that request.auth.uid matched the owner or an authorized role; fixed in commit 1c24da0 and used as the pattern to watch for in future rule reviews.

nodes.label: checkAlertsDaily N+1 query fix (commit 18706e9)
nodes.rationale: Iterating documents and doing a per-item .get()/query inside a loop caused N+1 reads; fixed by batching (getAll, in-queries, Promise.all over a single aggregated query, or denormalization). Used as the reference pattern for future performance reviews.
